description: SAMO’s RETURN is an extended play record that broadcasts my journey of dealing with cycles that often are good or bad. Cycles must have a beginning and end and it is extremely difficult to exit. SAMO means an end to something and the start of something bigger influenced by Jean Basquiat, SAMO began with the “basement blues press” as an ideal yet imaginary guilt free religion. With my list of creative expressions “Be mine, One & only, Best friend, Dangerous, LSD, and Stand still” I demonstrate what SAMO means to me. The expression of love and freedom, the religion of love, We see ourselves in a constant loop in today's cycles with relations. The hassle of choices, the hassle of the unknown we choose who we want but not what we need. (Choose Wisely)
